title: Thanks
description: Historical OpenStack logo-request confirmation text. The preview does not submit licensing inquiries or create support tickets.
body:
Thank you for the request for trademark licensing information.  We will respond as soon as possible.

Your request has automatically created a ticket with our ticketing system for tracking. Other helpful links:

  • Trademark Policy
  • Web Badges
  • Follow up:  logo@openstack.org
